summary: Lead Real Estate Co., Ltd, a Tokyo-based operative builder listed on a US exchange and filing as a foreign private issuer, reported the results of its 26th Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders held September 29, 2026, with a quorum present. Shareholders approved a JPY10 per ordinary share year-end cash dividend totaling JPY136,419,000, effective September 30, 2026; reappointed directors Eiji Nagahara, Hidekazu Hamagishi, and Kenichi Homma; and approved amendments to the officer retirement allowance regulations. This is a routine AGM results filing, not a special situation.
